hook: Why Tony keeps losing jobs he never even knew about
cta_sub: AI that texts every lead back in 60 seconds

beats.say: Three missed calls today. I was up on a roof, I couldn't answer.
Called them all back after work. Two already hired somebody else.
That's two jobs. Gone. And I never even got to quote them.
Tony. You didn't lose them because of your price. You lost them because of the clock.

I'm Jarvis. Here's what most contractors don't know. Harvard Business Review research found that replying within five minutes makes you twenty one times more likely to qualify a lead, compared to waiting thirty.
Twenty one times? I usually call back at night.
Which is why I text every lead within sixty seconds. I ask what's wrong with the roof, how urgent it is, and offer your open inspection slots.
And if they ask how much?
I tell them the inspection is free, and you'll give a written quote on site. No guessing.
Already handled. All three got a text. One just booked for tomorrow at ten.
You booked a job while I was eating dinner?
If you're a contractor losing jobs to missed calls, DM the word BUILD, and Jarvis Works will set me up for your business.
